about_intro: Oorja â€” Sanskrit for energy â€” is the name behind a new kind of ecosystem for India's gig riders.
about_history_text: Oorja is built on more than 35 years of experience in retail and customer handling. That experience â€” running stores, managing teams, and staying close to customers day after day â€” taught one lesson above everything else: a business only lasts when the people doing the hardest, most visible work are treated as partners, not just hands on the ground.
about_why_text:
India's delivery and gig economy runs on millions of riders, but the system around them rarely runs in their favour. Rising fuel costs eat into daily earnings. Owning a vehicle is often out of reach. Insurance, servicing, and safety are left for riders to figure out on their own, with little support from the platforms they ride for.

Oorja exists to change that â€” by building a complete EV ecosystem designed around the rider, not around extracting the most from them.
stand_equality_desc: Every rider gets a fair shot, not just the ones with capital or connections.
stand_profit_desc: Lower running costs than petrol, and a path to owning the vehicle instead of renting it for life.
stand_support_desc: Financing, insurance, servicing, and safety built into the model, not bolted on as an afterthought.
stand_sustain_desc: A cleaner, electric alternative that's better for riders and for the cities they ride in.
about_promise_text: Oorja isn't just an EV brand. It's an ecosystem built around the rider â€” their income, their vehicle, their safety, and their future. Bringing three and a half decades of retail and customer-first thinking into the gig economy, our promise is simple: energy and equality for every rider, every ride.
services_intro: Oorja isn't just about the vehicle. It's about everything a gig rider needs to earn more, ride safer, and build a future â€” all in one place.
srv_rto_desc: Getting through RTO paperwork alone is one of the biggest headaches for a rider. We help with:
srv_rto_2: Getting retrofit installations approved and made RTO-compliant
srv_rto_4: General hand-holding through processes riders don't have the time (or patience) to deal with themselves
srv_retro_desc: Not every rider needs a new EV â€” sometimes converting the vehicle they already own is the smarter move. We help riders:
srv_retro_1: Decide whether retrofitting their existing vehicle actually makes sense for them
srv_retro_2: Connect with trustworthy, vetted retrofit providers
srv_retro_3: Understand the process end to end â€” what to check, what to ask, and how to get it properly certified
srv_ins_desc: Most riders have no idea what they're actually covered for â€” or what they're missing. We help riders understand and access:
srv_ins_2: Personal accident insurance â€” critical for someone who spends 8â€“10 hours a day on the road
srv_ins_4: Standard vehicle insurance, explained in plain language
srv_ins_note: The goal isn't just to sell a policy â€” it's to make sure every rider actually knows what protection they have, and where the gaps are.

srv_road_desc: A breakdown or a flat tyre shouldn't cost a rider a full day's earnings. Our on-site road support is available round the clock, including:

eco_title: Ecosystem Watch: What's Really Happening for Gig Riders
eco_intro: Everyone in this space talks about their own slice of the pie â€” an app here, an EV scooter there, a delivery target somewhere else. Almost nobody is talking about the rider's whole life: their paperwork, their protection, their savings, their everyday gear. That's the gap Oorja exists to close. Here's what's actually happening around us, and why a complete ecosystem matters more than any single piece of it.
eco_gov_title: Government: The Safety Net Is Being Built, Piece by Piece
eco_gov_desc1: Nationally, gig and platform workers finally have a legal identity. The Code on Social Security, 2020 was the first law to define who a "gig worker" even is, and it set up a framework for aggregators to fund welfare schemes â€” a small percentage of platform payments flowing into a central Social Security Fund. Riders can register on the government's e-Shram portal to get a Universal Account Number, which connects them to benefits like PM-JAY health cover and e-Shram accident insurance.
eco_gov_desc2: On the EV side, the PM E-DRIVE scheme puts real money toward electric two- and three-wheeler purchases â€” a subsidy of a few thousand rupees per vehicle â€” alongside a nationwide push to build tens of thousands of public charging points. The subsidy amount and deadline have both shifted more than once as the scheme has matured, so it's worth checking the live terms before any purchase decision.
eco_gov_desc3: Closer to home, Karnataka has gone further than almost any other state. The Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Act, 2025 is the first law of its kind in the country. It sets up a dedicated Welfare Board headquartered right here in Bengaluru, gives every gig worker a unique ID that follows them across platforms, funds a welfare pool through a small levy on aggregator payments, and limits how and when a platform can deactivate a rider without notice. Rollout is still in progress â€” the board, registration portal, and fee-verification system are being phased in â€” but the direction is clear: riders are starting to gain rights, not just gig work.
eco_gov_desc4: Other states are moving too â€” Rajasthan passed an early version of this law, Maharashtra is pushing delivery platforms toward mandatory electric fleets and a rider welfare levy, and Delhi has started requiring aggregator fleets to shift to electric or CNG vehicles.
eco_comp_title: Companies: Big EV Promises, But Only for Their Own Piece
eco_comp_desc1: The big platforms have made bold commitments â€” Zomato and Swiggy have both pledged fully electric delivery fleets by 2030, and several EV-rental and battery-swapping players have stepped in to help riders switch without paying upfront for a new vehicle.
eco_comp_desc2: That's genuinely useful. But notice what it doesn't cover: a rider can switch to an EV through one of these programs and still have no real idea what insurance they hold, no plan for their savings, no help with RTO paperwork, and no reliable place to buy tyres or gear. A Karnataka High Court judge made this point sharply in a recent case, observing that platforms like Swiggy and Zomato are, in a practical sense, just a building and an app â€” the vehicle, and everything that comes with owning and running it, sits entirely with the rider.
eco_oorja_desc: Government policy is building the legal and financial scaffolding. Platforms are building EV fleets. Almost nobody is building around the rider as a whole person. Oorja brings RTO help, retrofitting guidance, insurance clarity, real investment options, everyday products, and roadside support into one place â€” so a rider isn't stuck managing ten separate relationships just to do one job well.

beyond_subtitle2: क्योंकि कोई और सवार के चारों ओर संपूर्ण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र का निर्माण नहीं कर रहा है।
beyond_grievance_desc: कर्नाटक का नया गिग-वर्कर कानून प्रत्येक पंजीकृत राइडर को प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर उनके खाते को निष्क्रिय करने से पहले नोटिस करने और उचित शिकायत प्रक्रिया का अधिकार देता है। अधिकांश सवारों को यह पता नहीं है कि यह अधिकार मौजूद है, इसका उपयोग कैसे किया जाए इसकी तो बात ही छोड़िए। ऊर्जा सवारों को उनके अधिकारों को समझने, सही तरीके से शिकायत दर्ज करने और गलत तरीके से निष्क्रिय किए जाने पर उनका खाता वापस पाने में मदद करती है।
beyond_women_desc: आजीविका के लिए सवारी वास्तविक सुरक्षा चिंताओं के साथ आती है जिन्हें बड़े प्लेटफॉर्म अभी भी हल नहीं कर पाए हैं। ऊर्जा का सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम महिला सवारों को असुरक्षित ग्राहकों को चिह्नित करने का एक तरीका, आपात स्थिति के लिए एक एसओएस विकल्प और सुरक्षा-विशिष्ट प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करता है - जो महिलाओं के वास्तविक ऑन-रोड अनुभव के आधार पर बनाया गया है, न कि किसी बाद के विचार के रूप में।
beyond_family_desc: Every insurance product in this market — including the new government schemes — covers the rider alone. But most riders are their family's main earner. Oorja extends health and accident cover to a rider's spouse and children too, so one bad day on the road doesn't put the whole family at risk.
prod_footer: यह सूची बढ़ती रहेगी - यदि किसी टमटम सवार को अपना काम बेहतर ढंग से करने के लिए इसकी आवश्यकता है, तो ऊर्जा को इसे खोजने के लिए एक जगह होनी चाहिए।
